# voipms_phonebook_entry (Data Source)

Reads a phonebook entry by id (`getPhonebook`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_phonebook_entry" "blocked_prefix" {
  id = "476494"
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Phonebook entry id.

### Read-Only

- `callerid` (String) Caller ID name override.
- `group` (String) Phonebook group id.
- `group_name` (String) Phonebook group name.
- `name` (String) Contact name.
- `note` (String) Note.
- `number` (String) Phone number or prefix.
- `speed_dial` (String) Speed-dial code.
